repair_notes.scope: Reusable realizations for the 19 previously failing examples; explicit stems and receiver-owned allomorphs.
repair_notes.evidence: Compositional grammatical analysis; not a claim that every exact long word is independently attested.

meaning_notes.counterexample-02: The promise reading requires a contextual object; the verb means maintain/uphold.
meaning_notes.counterexample-08: The experiencer (I/you/etc.) is contextual, not encoded as first-person agreement.
meaning_notes.counterexample-10: Perfect plus nonpast undu may have inferential or future-reference readings; plurality versus honorific reference is contextual.
meaning_notes.batch3-01: The conditional does not encode second-person you.
meaning_notes.batch3-02: Concessive can be even if or even though; time is context-dependent.
meaning_notes.batch3-06: Audibility reading: because it was not audible/was not heard. This chain has negation, not an explicit inability morpheme. Causative make-hear is another lexical analysis.
meaning_notes.batch3-07: Extent/limit reading, not a fixed English tense translation.
meaning_notes.batch3-09: Reportative indicates reported information; they versus honorific singular is unresolved.
meaning_notes.batch3-10: The thinking is past; the prohibition is in its complement. This does not alone encode English counterfactual should not have.

limitations: Some lexical compounds are registered as bases.
Search bounds and ambiguity are reported.

repair_notes_v3.modern: Explicit stem paradigms, honorific oblique cases, quotative and oo clitics, contracted reportative, full obligative relative and lexically licensed motion vector.
repair_notes_v3.literary: 20 compositional derivations using bounded lexical members, reversible receiver-owned Sanskrit boundary choices, nominal inflection, and literary predication. Exact source attestation and semantic grouping of the complete 20 forms remain unverified.

repair_notes_v4.scope: 35 new examples; lexical stems, embedded seem/say, hortative, imperative, negative command, benefactive vector, unavoidability, contracted perfect/possibility, relative nominal homography and fused interrogative.
repair_notes_v4.semantics: Partial operator expression; receiver-owned outer negation preserves two nested not operators and a distinct double-negative feature summary.
repair_notes_v4.evidence: Krishnamurti and Gwynn 1985, chapters 16-21, 29 and 30; compositional review does not certify exact full-word attestation.
